content.text:
I added a welcome email on user creation and a password reset email, using Resend as the provider. Lint passes and my new files type-check. `tsc` does report one error, in `src/app/layout.tsx`: `Cannot find name 'LayoutProps'`. I didn't touch that file, and I didn't run the app or send a real email.

I chose Resend for its simple REST API and its free tier. I call it with plain `fetch`, so there is no new dependency.

- **`src/lib/email.ts`:** `sendEmail`, `sendWelcomeEmail` and `sendPasswordResetEmail`. If `RESEND_API_KEY` or `EMAIL_FROM` is unset, emails are logged to the console instead of sent, so local dev works. User names are HTML-escaped in the email body.
- **`createUser`:** `src/lib/users.ts` had no way to create a user, so I added `createUser({ email, name })`. It rejects duplicate emails and sends the welcome email. A send failure is logged and doesn't fail signup.
- **`requestPasswordReset(email)`:** creates a random token that expires in 1 hour. Only a hash of it is stored, and the email links to `${APP_URL}/reset-password?token=…`. It resolves the same way whether or not the email is registered, so it doesn't reveal which emails have accounts.
- **`consumePasswordResetToken(token)`:** checks a token and consumes it. It's single-use and returns the user it belongs to, or `undefined` if the token is invalid or expired.
- **`.env.example`:** placeholders for `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM` and `APP_URL`. `.gitignore` ignored every `.env*` file, so I added an exception for `.env.example`.

- **Still missing:** there is no `/reset-password` page, no signup route and no password storage. The repo has no auth layer yet, so `consumePasswordResetToken` only validates the token. Setting the new password has to come from whatever auth you add.
- **In-memory storage:** reset tokens live in memory, the same as the user list. They are lost on restart and don't work across multiple server instances. Move them to the database when you add one.
- **Before production:** verify your sending domain in Resend and use that address for `EMAIL_FROM`.
